title: Sounding rocket for launch in 2027 to be shipped to PH in October – PhilSA
summary: The sounding rocket set for launching in the Philippines in 2027 will be shipped to the country by October, according to Philippine Space Agency's (PhilSA) budget sponsor Representative John Yap.
